turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's not waste them. Why was a zero entered on Owen's essay before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Okay. I'm still waiting for an answer, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who entered the zero, and what do you have?
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
Then why are we here, Hale? Withdraw the zero, or tell me what you have that justifies it.
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
"Together." You entered the zero alone, Hale. I'm writing that down, and I'll want the procedure you followed in an email.
